lessons.title: Ordering Drinks

items.example: Ich hätte gerne einen Kaffee, bitte.
items.exampleMeaning: I would like a coffee, please.
I would like a water, please.
Do you have green tea?
I will take an apple juice.

items.meaning: I would like something to drink.
items.example: Ich möchte etwas zu trinken, bitte.
items.exampleMeaning: I would like something to drink, please.
What do you recommend here?

lessons.tip: In German, it’s polite to say 'bitte' (please) when ordering. Use 'Danke' (thank you) after receiving your order.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: What would you like to drink?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ich hätte gerne einen Kaffee, bitte.
dialogue.meaning: I would like a coffee, please.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Do you have tea?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ja, ich hätte gerne einen Tee.
dialogue.meaning: Yes, I would like a tea.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Would you like something to eat?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Nein, danke. Nur ein Wasser, bitte.
dialogue.meaning: No, thank you. Just a water, please.

scenario.brief: You are at a café. Ask for a drink and respond to the staff's questions.
scenario.goal: You need to order a drink politely.

lessons.title: Ordering Food

items.example: Ich hätte gerne ein Sandwich mit Käse.
items.exampleMeaning: I would like a sandwich with cheese.
I will take a piece of chocolate cake.
Do you have fresh bread?

items.meaning: I would like something to eat.
items.example: Ich möchte etwas zu essen, bitte.
items.exampleMeaning: I would like something to eat, please.
How much does the sandwich cost?
I will take that piece of cake.

lessons.tip: When ordering food, you can say 'Ich hätte gerne...' (I would like...) to be polite. Remember to say 'Danke' after you receive your food.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: What would you like to eat?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ich hätte gerne ein Sandwich, bitte.
dialogue.meaning: I would like a sandwich, please.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Do you have bread?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ja, ich hätte gerne frisches Brot.
dialogue.meaning: Yes, I would like fresh bread.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: How much does the piece of cake cost?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ich nehme das Stück Kuchen, bitte.
dialogue.meaning: I will take that piece of cake, please.

scenario.brief: You are at a café. Ask for food and respond to the staff's questions.
scenario.goal: You need to order food politely.

lessons.title: Using Numbers 1-20

items.exampleMeaning: I would like one coffee, please.
I will take two sandwiches.

items.example: Ich hätte gerne drei Stück Kuchen.
items.exampleMeaning: I would like three pieces of cake.
I will order four cups of tea.
I would like five waters, please.
That costs ten euros.

lessons.tip: Numbers in German are important for ordering. Practice counting from one to twenty for better understanding.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: How many sandwiches would you like?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: I will take two sandwiches, please.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: And how many pieces of cake?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ich hätte gerne drei Stück Kuchen.
dialogue.meaning: I would like three pieces of cake.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: That costs ten euros.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: Thank you!

scenario.brief: You are at a café. Use numbers to order drinks and food.
scenario.goal: You need to order using numbers politely.

lessons.title: Polite Expressions

items.exampleMeaning: Thank you for the coffee!
Please, come again!
Excuse me, where is the bathroom?
Could I get the bill?

items.example: Ich danke Ihnen für Ihre Hilfe.
items.exampleMeaning: I thank you for your help.

items.example: Das ist nett von Ihnen, danke!
items.exampleMeaning: That is nice of you, thank you!

lessons.tip: Using polite expressions like 'Danke' and 'Bitte' is important in German culture. Always be polite when speaking.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Excuse me! Do you have the bill?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ja, natürlich. Ich bringe sie sofort.
dialogue.meaning: Yes, of course. I will bring it right away.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Thank you!

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: You’re welcome! Please come again!

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Could I have a water?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ja, ich bringe es Ihnen gleich.
dialogue.meaning: Yes, I will bring it to you right away.

scenario.brief: You are at a café. Use polite expressions when ordering and asking for the bill.
scenario.goal: You need to show politeness in your requests.
